items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: You know him, that's Mr. Hughes. Yeah, yeah, he was.

ctx.x: But it left me feeling good. Mm-hmm. Good.

And I was standing up on my head. It wasn't a little ahead up there. I felt it good. So, when my partner come and released me that morning. I went on to the camp and I told the boy, I said, well, I'm going to tell all you fellas something. What you got to tell us this morning? I said, I ain't going to be here with y'all long. He said, oh, man, hush that racket. You know better than that. I said, okay. I said, just watch it. Well, I pulled my clothes off and I went to bed. I lay on my face. Somebody come in and…
